title: Fixed Part Lowered Pivot Wall Bed
description: One original complete static wall-bed assembly in a partly lowered display pose. A full grounded tall cabinet has a real open storage chamber. Paired side pivot bearings support one entire inclined bed unit with an outer closure panel, full side/end rails, six complete support slats, a thick bevelled mattress and head pillow. Two fixed stays and one whole folded underside U foot complete the mechanism appearance. No existing bed, cot or secretary-cabinet mesh imported or resized. Three opaque PBR materials, metre game units, Z-up, horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes and no host wall or room. The partly lowered bed and tucked foot are intentionally not in a grounded sleeping configuration. No folding animation, locking, balance, lift assistance, sleeping suitability, load capacity, attachment, manufacture, installation or safety certification is claimed.
